name: whale-coupons
description: Coupon and discount codes issued by independent online stores. Look up a code by store name, website domain or product URL, search stores by product category, or list the largest discounts. Hosted, read-only remote server: no account or API key.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server. No sign-in or API key.

tools.name: find_coupons
tools.description: Find the coupon code for a store by name, website domain or product URL.

tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Find stores with discount codes for a product type or shopping category, such as running shoes or skincare.

tools.name: get_store
tools.description: Full code details for one store from an earlier result.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List store categories with links to each category page.

tools.name: list_largest_discounts
tools.description: Stores with the biggest percentage-off codes, optionally within a category.

examples.title: Store code
examples.description: Find a code for a named store
examples.prompt: Is there a promo code for Saguaro Barefoot Shoes?

examples.title: Product page
examples.description: Find a code from a product URL
examples.prompt: Find a discount code for this product: <product URL>

examples.title: Category
examples.description: Find stores with codes for a product type
examples.prompt: Any coupon codes for pet stores?
